prompts.WoodTile: Use case: background-extraction. Create a production-ready Unity mobile orchard game UI sprite derived from the approved reference (the image is STYLE REFERENCE only). Truly transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard painted in. Polished casual-game painted 3D appearance, warm honey wood, softly rounded/bevelled corners, subtle grain, gentle upper-left light, restrained highlights; match reference closely. Isolated centered object filling most of the canvas with a small transparent margin. No text, numbers, symbols, leaves, extra ornaments or unrelated elements. Primary request: ONE empty square wooden button tile matching both the reference top-left level wood tile and tray expansion wood block. Front view flat to camera, nearly square, golden honey wood solid center with very subtle low-contrast grain. Fine cream edge highlight, thin darker brown inner recessed seam, gentle small shadow only inside the sprite. Keep large center completely empty for a separate dynamic number or separate lock icon. The tile itself must be square, no gear or lock or label.
